data_description.idle_unload_minutes: Free the model from memory after this many minutes without a request. Set to 0 to keep it loaded permanently.
data_description.streaming: Stream audio sentence-by-sentence as it's generated, so playback can start before a long message finishes synthesizing. Turn off to fall back to generating the whole message before returning any audio, if streaming causes issues with your media player.
data_description.stream_read_ahead: How many seconds of already-synthesized audio a background thread may build up ahead of what's already been sent, while streaming. Higher smooths over variance in per-sentence synthesis time (helps avoid audible gaps between sentences on slower hardware); never delays the very first sentence. 0 (default) computes it automatically from the last measured synthesis speed instead of a fixed number.
